message:
## Suggestion pull request cleanup stopped: the label does not mark suggestion pull requests

None of the 2 open pull requests labeled `suggestion` in mike-north/doc-linter has a suggestion marker or a `suggestion-pr/` branch, so the label does not look like a suggestion label, and nothing was checked or closed.

diagnostics.title: The label does not seem to mark suggestion pull requests
diagnostics.message: None of the 2 open pull requests labeled `suggestion` in mike-north/doc-linter has a suggestion marker or a `suggestion-pr/` branch, so the label does not look like a suggestion label, and nothing was checked or closed.
diagnostics.subject: mike-north/doc-linter
remedies: Check the label: `--label` names the label suggestion pull requests were left under.
If the label is right, run again with `--force` (library: `force: true`) to check every pull request carrying it.
